Chord Progression Generator

Generate chord progressions by key and mood, see the chords with roman numerals, and hear each one played.

Chords are harmonized from your key with real music theory and synthesized live with WebAudio.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a key and a mood.
  2. Choose a progression pattern.
  3. Click any chord chip to hear it, or "Play all" for the full sequence.
  4. Try different keys to hear how the mood changes.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which moods are available?

Happy, Sad, Epic, Chill, Jazzy and Dark — each mood has hand-picked progression patterns that are transposed to your key with real music theory.

Are the chords musically correct?

Chords are built from your key using proper harmonization (major/minor/diminished triads and 7ths), then played with a WebAudio synth.

Does it use audio files?

No — everything is synthesized live in your browser.
